<!-- Generated by scripts/docs-reference.mjs from packages/comments-core/src/errors.ts. Run `npm run docs:reference` rather than editing this file. -->

| Code | Category | HTTP status | When it happens |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `validation_failed` | `validation` | 422 | Something posted didn’t pass validation, such as an empty comment or a required field left out. `fieldErrors` says which. |
| `file_type_not_allowed` | `validation` | 422 | An upload’s type isn’t allowed, or its contents don’t match its extension. |
| `file_too_large` | `validation` | 422 | An upload is larger than the field or the server allows. |
| `too_many_files` | `validation` | 422 | More files than a field takes, or a guest’s address has too many uploads waiting to be posted. |
| `protection_required` | `protection` | 422 | A write arrived without the spam protection evidence it needs, or with a preparation that isn’t valid. |
| `protection_expired` | `protection` | 422 | The protection preparation ran out or was already used. Core fetches a new one and tries once more by itself. |
| `protection_unavailable` | `protection` | 503 | The spam protection service couldn’t be reached. Trying again later can work. |
| `challenge_failed` | `protection` | 422 | The visitor didn’t pass a challenge, such as Turnstile’s. Never retried automatically. |
| `possible_spam` | `protection` | 422 | Protect judged the comment to be spam. Never retried automatically. |
| `rate_limited` | `rate` | 429 | Too many requests from one address. `retryAfter` says how many seconds to wait. |
| `sign_in_required` | `auth` | 401 | The action needs a signed-in member, or a request on another site came without a member token. |
| `token_expired` | `auth` | 401 | A member token ran out. `memberToken()` fetches the next one and tries once more. |
| `token_revoked` | `auth` | 401 | A member token was revoked or isn’t known, or its member changed their password since it was minted. |
| `session_expired` | `auth` | 401 | A guest’s session token ran out, changed or moved. The sign-in provider starts a new session and tries once more. |
| `origin_not_allowed` | `auth` | 403 | The request’s origin doesn’t fit its profile, or isn’t listed in **Other Sites** with what it needs. |
| `csrf_failed` | `auth` | 403 | A cookie sign-in’s write came without a valid CSRF token. `cookieSession()` reads a new token and tries once more. |
| `signature_invalid` | `auth` | 401 | A signed `member-token` or `revoke-member-tokens` request from a site’s own server has a missing, wrong, old or repeated signature. |
| `user_not_eligible` | `auth` | 403 | A `member-token` request named a user who can’t have one, such as a suspended or unknown user. |
| `forbidden` | `policy` | 403 | The person can’t do this to this comment, such as voting where voting is off or editing someone else’s comment. |
| `blocked` | `policy` | 403 | The person is blocked from taking part. |
| `closed` | `policy` | 403 | The thread is closed to new comments. |
| `edit_window_passed` | `policy` | 403 | The comment can no longer be edited or deleted by its author. |
| `not_found` | `state` | 404 | The owner, comment or thread doesn’t exist or isn’t public, or has comments turned off. |
| `conflict` | `state` | 409 | The comment changed since it was loaded. Load it again before saving. |
| `limit_exceeded` | `request` | 400 | A request asked for too many items at once. |
| `invalid_cursor` | `request` | 400 | A page’s cursor isn’t valid any more, such as after the sort or limit changed. Load the thread again. |
| `method_not_allowed` | `request` | 405 | The action was called with the wrong HTTP method. |
| `unsupported_api_version` | `request` | 400 | The server and the package read different versions of the JSON format, usually a page left open across an upgrade. Reloading fixes it. |
| `server_error` | `server` | 500 | The server failed, or answered with an error page rather than the data API’s JSON. |
| `network_error` | `network` | None, raised by core | The request never reached the server, or was abandoned after the timeout. |
| `invalid_response` | `server` | None, raised by core | The answer wasn’t the data API’s JSON, such as a proxy’s page or a body without `apiVersion`. |
| `invalid_request` | `request` | 400 | The request couldn’t be read, such as a body that isn’t a JSON object or a profile the API doesn’t know. |
